title: Blackhawk Golf Course
specs: Nine-hole course with challenging yet playable layout along Spring Brook Creek
Soft spikes required; metal spikes prohibited

Dress code: shoes and shirt required; tank tops allowed; men encouraged to wear golf style or khaki pants or shorts, collared shirts with sleeves; jeans welcome; basketball/athletic shorts discouraged; ladies may wear golf skirts, skorts, shorts, or pants and collared shirts sleeved or sleeveless
Golf outings up to 48 players; event booking available by contacting General Manager
